improvement: Plugin Center icons use the sizes, positions, light and dark artwork, and circular backgrounds adjusted in Icon Studio, retaining reproducible sources and parameters
Raise compileSdk and targetSdk to 37 (Android 17); the plugin's behavior does not depend on the new target
fix: SDK XML v4 parsing warnings with AGP 9.1 and APK native alignment checks incorrectly triggered by JVM unit-test assembly tasks, using shared build plugins 1.8.3

improvement: Validate release APK versions, signing and the complete variant set before creating download artifacts
Images may contain at most 16777216 pixels; raw image buffers are limited to 64 MiB
Extend native ABI packaging and plugin metadata to arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86 and x86_64, with matching universal and per-ABI APKs
fix: Plugin center version and ABI information matches the installed plugin APK
Encoded image input is limited to 64 MiB and supports file descriptors and pipes
Version dates use a consistent English format

improvement: Build verification of 16 KB page alignment for 64-bit native libraries, including manifest contract checks and JSON reports

feature: Added the ML Kit Chinese OCR plugin service with plugin ID `mlkit-ocr-chinese`, engine `mlkit-ocr`, and variant `chinese`
Added host discovery and invocation through the shared OCR AIDL action `org.autojs.plugin.PADDLE_OCR`
Added `recognizeText` and `detect` interfaces that return recognized text, confidence values, and text line bounds
Added support for encoded image input and raw `ARGB_8888` image buffers, with a SharedMemory read path preferred on Android 13 and later

Added localized plugin metadata and usage instructions for Spanish, French, Russian, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, English, Simplified Chinese, Hong Kong Traditional Chinese, and Taiwan Traditional Chinese
Added JSON sources and `.python/generate_markdown.py` generation for README and CHANGELOG files
Added ABI split APK builds for `arm64-v8a`, `armeabi-v7a`, `x86_64`, and a `universal` APK
Release APK filenames now include the version, ABI variant, and CRC32 digest
improvement: Standardize the README layout and Gradle platform version management
Refine the plugin description and normalize punctuation in multilingual resources
